notes: S1-FIX4 W7/§11.9 (order of the zip checks): the archive declares two 600,000,000-byte blobs, above MAX_CONTAINER_UNCOMPRESSED_BYTES, and one byte precedes the first local file header while every offset is shifted to match, so the central directory parses but the archive fails phase 1 (a non-empty archive starts with a local header at offset 0) before the limits are reached. Phases run locate -> parse central directory -> §13 limits -> remaining rules, so the container is invalid E_CONTAINER_ZIP only.
